parameters.title: Machine learning model registry.
parameters.label: Register final machine learning models in the ml_model schema.

parameters.title: Register a saved regression model as a final model
parameters.label: Writes the model path, sha256, manifest, preprocessing steps, metrics and parameter sets used to the ml_model schema and freezes those parameter sets. A registered model can be applied by name with predict_independent.

parameter.hint: Comma separated list of saved models (.joblib) with their .manifest.json, paths relative to the project root.
Registry name (single model only); empty = the model file name without .joblib.
Short description of the model (purpose, data, limitations).

parameters.title: Retire registered models
parameters.label: Sets the status of registered models to retired: they can no longer be applied by name. The record, metrics and frozen parameter sets are kept.

parameter.hint: Comma separated list of registered model names.
